AboutMe.title: My Trajectory to Becoming a Software Developer
AboutMe.intro: With an unwavering passion for technology, my journey as a software developer began as a hobby, exploring personal projects. It was during the lockdown that I reassessed my professional trajectory and decided to fully dedicate myself to the field.
AboutMe.tech: With solid experience in JavaScript and Next.js, coupled with expertise in Firebase and GraphQL, I have forged my path in web development. Currently, I am immersed in my studies of Software Engineering at the University of Franca, strengthening my theoretical and practical foundation.

Projects.title: Making Ideas Come to Life!
Projects.minasDesc: Web platform developed by me and used by the secretariat of culture of Minas Gerais (SECULT), for management, control and professional training of demands generated by the municipalities.
Projects.gs3Desc: Geotechnical and structural monitoring software to centralize instrument data, stability analysis, time series analysis, and trigger alarms with speed and traceability, among other features.
Projects.naviaDesc: Navia is a complete management platform designed to connect consultants and clients efficiently. Our solution centralizes projects, simplifies processes, and facilitates communication, offering everything you need to scale your consultancy and deliver results with excellence and transparency.
Projects.repDesc: Application developed in flutter framework and with database in firebase. Mobile platform with multiple functionality such as airline tickets, hotels, digital banking and its main function comes with urban mobility.
